name: 94129 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94129 (San Francisco) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94129 (San Francisco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
59% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
